# kion_idms_open_id (Resource)

Manages a Kion OpenID Connect identity management system (IDMS).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kion_idms_open_id" "example" {
  # Optional
  # access_rules = [{
  #   assertion_name             = "example"
  #   assertion_regex            = "example"
  #   cloudtamer_access_level_id = 1
  # }]
  # authorization_endpoint = "example"
  # client_id              = "example"
  # email_claim            = "example"
  # first_name_claim       = "example"
  # issuer                 = "example"
  # jwks_uri               = "example"
  # last_name_claim        = "example"
  # name                   = "example"
  # phone_claim            = "example"
  # scopes                 = []
  # username_claim         = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `access_rules` (Attributes List) AccessRules defines the console access defined for matching users in Kion (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--access_rules))
- `authorization_endpoint` (String) AuthorizationEndpoint is the endpoint the OpenID provider determines to kick off the authentication process
- `client_id` (String) ClientID that links Kion to the OpenID Provider, determined when configuring OpenID
- `email_claim` (String) EmailClaim defines an optional mapping of an OpenID claim value to a user's email attribute in Kion
- `first_name_claim` (String) FirstNameClaim defines an optional mapping of an OpenID claim value to a user's first name attribute in Kion
- `issuer` (String) Issuer is the URL for the OpenID Provider
- `jwks_uri` (String) JwksURI describes the endpoint of an OpenID provider used to retrieve token security information for validation
- `last_name_claim` (String) LastNameClaim defines an optional mapping of an OpenID claim value to a user's last name attribute in Kion
- `name` (String) Name of the OpenID in the application.
- `phone_claim` (String) PhoneClaim defines an optional mapping of an OpenID claim value to a user's phone attribute in Kion
- `scopes` (Set of String) Scopes define the claim variables that an OpenID provider will include in an auth request. Specifics depend on the OpenID provider.
- `username_claim` (String) UsernameClaim defines an optional mapping of an OpenID claim value to a user's username attribute in Kion. Required to uniquely identify users

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) OpenID IDMS ID.

<a id="nestedatt--access_rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `access_rules`

Optional:

- `assertion_name` (String) AssertionName name of the assertion in OpenID.
- `assertion_regex` (String) AssertionRegex is the regular expression used to determine a match.
- `cloudtamer_access_level_id` (Number) CloudtamerAccessLevelID is the ID that represents access level. 1 represents full access, 2 represents no cloud account access and 3 represents no access.
